name: KudosBlock – Display Testimonials, Reviews, & Social Proof
author: Upluggit

sections.description:
KudosBlock is a purpose-built Gutenberg block that lets you create beautiful testimonial, reviews, & social proof sections directly inside the WordPress block editor. It works completely offline with zero external dependencies — your testimonial data lives in your post content, loads instantly, and never phones home.

Whether you run a local bakery, a design studio, a consulting firm, or a nonprofit, this block helps you put real voices front and center on your site.

What you can do

  • Add unlimited testimonials — each with a name, testimonial text, subtitle (use it for location, role, company, or anything else), and a 0–5 star rating.
  • Upload headshots — add a rounded avatar photo to each testimonial for a personal touch.
  • Choose Grid or Carousel layout — a responsive CSS grid for structured pages, or a horizontally scrollable carousel for a more dynamic feel.
  • Enable auto-scroll — when using the carousel, turn on a smooth continuous scroll animation with adjustable speed and direction (right-to-left or left-to-right). Navigation arrows hide automatically so the experience stays clean.
  • Pick Card or Minimal style — boxed cards with rounded corners and subtle shadows, or a clean flat design with simple dividers.
  • Control card size — small, medium, or large presets that auto-adjust padding, font sizes, and spacing so content always looks proportional.
  • Set columns (grid) — from 1 to 5 columns, with automatic responsive fallbacks on smaller screens.
  • Fine-tune six independent colors — rating stars, card border, card background, name text, testimonial text, and subtitle text each get their own color picker.
  • Align text — left, center, or right, applied to every card.
  • Reorder with one click — move testimonials up or down in the sidebar repeater without dragging.
  • See a live preview — every change you make in the sidebar is reflected instantly in the editor canvas.

Use cases

  1. Local businesses — a restaurant showing diner reviews, a salon featuring client feedback, a repair shop displaying customer praise.
  2. Freelancers and agencies — highlight client testimonials on a portfolio or services page with name, role, and company as the subtitle.
  3. SaaS and product sites — display user quotes alongside star ratings on a landing page.
  4. Nonprofits and community organizations — share volunteer or donor stories with location badges.
  5. Online courses and coaches — display student success stories with the course name as the subtitle.
  6. Event and conference sites — feature attendee feedback from past events.
  7. Real estate and property management — show tenant or buyer testimonials with the property location.
  8. Healthcare and wellness — present patient or client experiences (with permission) in a clean, trustworthy layout.

Why this block?

  • Zero external dependencies — no jQuery, no Slick, no Swiper, no Google Fonts. Just clean CSS and a tiny vanilla JS file for the carousel.
  • No API keys or accounts — works fully offline, right out of the box.
  • Static output — testimonial markup is saved directly into the post content, so pages render fast even without JavaScript.
  • Accessible — keyboard-navigable carousel, focus management, pause-on-hover, and pause-when-hidden for auto-scroll.
  • Lightweight — minimal CSS footprint, no render-blocking resources.

Feedback & Suggestions

We would love to hear from you! If you have ideas for new features, layout options, or improvements that would make this block more useful for your site, please share your feedback:

  • WordPress.org support forum — open a topic on the plugin’s support page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kudos-block folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen by searching for “KudosBlock”.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the block editor on any page or post, click the + inserter, and search for Testimonial Display.
  4. Add your testimonials using the sidebar panel and customize the layout, style, and colors to match your site.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin connect to any external service?

No. All data is stored in the block attributes within your post content. No external API calls are made, and no data leaves your site.

Can I import reviews from Google, Yelp, or other platforms?

This block is designed for manually entered testimonials. It does not pull reviews from external platforms. You can copy and paste reviews into the block if you have permission to republish them.

Is there a limit on how many testimonials I can add?

No. You can add as many testimonials as you need.

What is the subtitle field for?

The subtitle is a flexible text field beneath the name. Use it for anything — a city name, a job title, a company, a course name, or leave it empty.

Does the carousel auto-scroll work on mobile?

Yes. The auto-scroll animation runs on all devices. It pauses when the user touches or hovers over the carousel, and pauses again when the browser tab is hidden to save resources.

Can I change the direction of the auto-scroll?

Yes. When auto-scroll is enabled, a Scroll direction control appears in the sidebar beneath the speed slider. Choose Right to left (the default) for a standard ticker-style scroll, or Left to right to reverse the direction.

Can I use this block multiple times on the same page?

Yes, each block instance is independent with its own testimonials and settings.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Grid and carousel layouts with card and minimal styles.
  • Star ratings (0–5) with custom color.
  • Headshot upload with rounded avatar display.
  • Flexible subtitle field (location, role, position, company, etc.).
  • Six independent color controls: rating stars, card border, card background, name, testimonial text, subtitle.
  • Card size presets (small, medium, large) with auto-adjusting content.
  • Auto-scroll for carousel with adjustable speed, pause on hover/focus/visibility.
  • Scroll direction control for carousel auto-scroll — choose right-to-left (default) or left-to-right from the sidebar.
  • Unlimited testimonials with reorder controls.
  • Responsive grid with automatic column fallbacks.
  • Full alignment support (wide and full width).
